neighbours.label: the subject or focus words of a clause that follows a contrastive 'However,' or 'But', as against the same clause after an additive 'Also'/'And'
fire: The new law is popular. However, if we look only at the cities, we miss rural voters.
The mayor welcomed the report. But the report did not say who would pay.
Most doctors approve of the drug. However, the side effects remain poorly studied.
The team trained hard all year. But the coach still had doubts about the defence.
Solar power is growing fast. However, storage costs are still too high for many towns.
The museum reopened in May. But the east wing is still closed to visitors.
The plan sounds simple. However, only a few countries have tried it.
Prices fell last month. But the drop did not reach most shoppers.
quiet: The new law is popular. Also, if we look at the cities, we see many supporters.
The mayor welcomed the report. And the report said the state would pay.
Most doctors approve of the drug. Also, the benefits are well studied.
The team trained hard all year. And the coach was proud of the defence.
Solar power is growing fast. Also, panel prices keep falling for many towns.
The museum reopened in May. And the east wing is now open to visitors.
The plan sounds simple. Also, several countries have tried it.
Prices fell last month. And the drop reached most shoppers.

predictions: fire 0.15-0.3 on the first content words after 'However,' or 'But'; the same clause after 'Also' or 'And' below 0.05
notes: Card: peaks on content words right after 'However,' or 'But' (' only', ' statement', ' advance', ' conditions', ' liberty'); suppresses ' however'. Probe: 'But the statement' 0.221, 'However, if we focus only' 0.197, 'However, some ... dry conditions' 0.048; additive versions 0.004-0.023; in-sentence ', but the cost' 0.039. Weak pole on these inputs; median may miss 0.20.
